disclosure: This is a post-registration instrumentation-tolerance and source-provenance correction. The 0.04 rad tolerance was selected only from model-blind, zero-request live-settle measurements. The control-asset correction follows only from attempt-manifest provenance, without conditioning on behavioral outcomes, policy actions, or model outputs.

frozen_change.measurement: absolute quaternion geodesic residual between each requested movable-object orientation and its settled live orientation
frozen_change.runtime_rule: For prospective R002 DROID attempts only, the live layout gate applies the 0.04 rad tolerance uniformly to every registered movable object, direction, layout, seed, and model.
frozen_change.selection_rule: The round 0.04 rad bound was selected prospectively after the same deterministic 0.0353741686 rad cube settle residual exceeded the original bound across independent ali-owned simulator lanes and environment seeds before request zero.

control_asset_binding.audit_rule: Every DROID s=0 attempt manifest is audited. A behavioral row is denominator-eligible only if --control-scene-asset resolves to the exact original control USDA below and the file bytes match its SHA-256.
control_asset_binding.scientific_reason: Although active-object selection can hide the extra paired-clutter prim, the deterministic settled state differs across these USDA source paths. The substituted asset is therefore not evidence-equivalent to the registered control fixture.
control_asset_binding.s0_runtime_rule: Every fresh R002 s=0 attempt must bind the original control USDA as --control-scene-asset. The paired-clutter USDA remains available only as --paired-scene-asset for nonzero registered layouts.

prospective_application.asset_exclusion_rule: Any DROID s=0 row, including a row produced while R002 is being registered or implemented, is discovery-only and excluded when its attempt manifest binds the substituted paired-clutter USDA as --control-scene-asset. This rule is outcome-blind.
prospective_application.pre_r002_rule: Every DROID s=0 attempt made before an R002 implementation commit remains infrastructure-invalid even when its residual would pass 0.04 rad. No pre-R002 attempt may be reclassified.
prospective_application.retry_rule: Each affected matched pair requires a fresh LEFT capture and matched RIGHT replay under R001 plus R002; no cached pre-R002 LEFT observation may seed the new pair.
prospective_application.transition_rule: Non-s=0 attempts already running under the immutable pre-R002 runtime may complete. Any s=0 attempt they reject remains outside denominators and must be rerun prospectively under R002.
